subject: SIG submission: VM cadence, emergency rollback test & remediation witness
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: CriticalSec Audit Team <criticalsec@auditco.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG request — vuln scan cadence + proof of rollback test

Hi Marissa,

We're finalizing the SIG assessment for Finbridge and need a compact package showing Redwood's vulnerability management cadence and (critically) proof you ran an emergency rollback exercise in Q1. Specifically: 1) scan schedule for hosts/services that handle PII, 2) SLA for CVE remediation by risk tier, 3) a short attestation that a controlled rollback test occurred (steps + outcome), and 4) artifacts or links we can reference in the SIG submission.

Can you confirm you can provide these by EOD Apr 22? If you have a preferred evidence bundle link or deliverable, point us there.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Turner
Security Review Lead, Finbridge
alex.turner@finbridge.com

--
Criticalsec will be auditing the items above for SOC2 alignment.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Alex — thanks for the note. We can deliver the package and confirm the rollback exercise. High level plan:

- Deliverable: single evidence bundle (PDF + CSV artifacts) and a Drive folder with raw logs.
- Due date: EOD Thu Apr 22 (we'll aim Apr 21 to allow your review).
- Owners: Ben (security ops) owns SLA statement & CVE attestation; Kimberly (platform ops) owns runbook + logs; I'll assemble the SIG-ready packet and a one-page cover note.

Attachments I'll include in the bundle: redwood_vm_scan_summary_Q1_2027.pdf (scan cadence + findings summary), emergency_rollback_test_runbook_v2.pdf (playbook + test notes), cve-2027-09-remediation-log.csv (example remediation audit trail).

Ben/Kim — can you confirm you have the final CSV/logs and a short attestation line we can include for the SIG?

Marissa

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 08:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG request — vuln scan cadence + proof of rollback test

Marissa/Alex — short attestation below, and a note on SLA mapping.

Attestation (Ben Carter, Head of Security Ops): Redwood Inference confirms that vulnerability scans are run on a continuous schedule for production hosts (daily lightweight agent scans; weekly authenticated scans for core services; monthly full-host scans). For assets storing or processing PII, scans occur at minimum weekly with an automated triage rule-set. Emergency rollback exercises are executed quarterly against a representative service; the Q1 2027 exercise completed on 2027-03-28 and met objectives (failover, data integrity checks, rollback verification).

SLA mapping (summary):
- Critical CVE (public exploit or active exploitation): detection to mitigation plan within 24 hours; patch or mitigated within 72 hours or documented compensating control.
- High: detection to remediation plan within 7 days; complete within 30 days.
- Medium/Low: prioritized by business impact; <=90 days for low risk exceptions with approval.

I exported the remediation audit trail for the Q1 priority fix (cve-2027-09) as cve-2027-09-remediation-log.csv and placed it in the evidence folder.

Ben Carter
Head of Security Operations, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@finbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG request — vuln scan cadence + proof of rollback test

Alex — attaching the runbook and summarizing the rollback test artifact set below.

Attachment: emergency_rollback_test_runbook_v2.pdf (includes test plan, scope, roles, pre-checks, post-check validations)

Test summary (Q1 emergency rollback test, 2027-03-28):
- Scope: dedicated staging cluster simulating the production control plane for hosted inference endpoints (subset of region-us-west-2).
- Trigger: simulated data-corrupting deployment (intentional rollback scenario).
- Steps validated: automated routing to previous container image, KV cache restore verification, ephemeral worker draining, smoke tests for inference latency and correctness.
- Outcome: rollback completed in 18 minutes from trigger; automated smoke checks passed; incident timeline and logs exported (see Drive link).

Artifacts uploaded to Drive folder:
- orchestration-timeline-20270328.log
- smoke-test-results-20270328.json
- rollback-exec-trace-20270328.txt

I'll also include a short runbook excerpt in the SIG packet that highlights rollback run criteria and operator sign-off points.

Kimberly Park
Principal Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

A couple of follow-ups before we mark the SIG item closed: 1) can you add a one-sentence sign-off from Engineering on the rollback test owner (name + title), and 2) we need a timestamped screenshot of the smoke-test dashboard showing pass/fail from the run (a PNG in the bundle is fine).

If you can drop those into the Drive folder by EOD Apr 22 I'll go ahead and reference the artifacts in the SIG. If you prefer, send me a DocuSign link for a short attestation form and we'll sign.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Alex
